name: io.github.nicolasboattini/esxi-readonly-mcp
title: ESXi Read-Only Diagnostics
description: Read-only VMware ESXi diagnostics: CPU Ready, disk latency, snapshots, real space, hardware health.

environmentVariables.name: ESXI_HOST
environmentVariables.description: ESXi host (or vCenter) IP or hostname

environmentVariables.name: ESXI_USER
environmentVariables.description: ESXi user with a read-only role. Store its password with 'esxi-readonly-mcp --set-password'

environmentVariables.name: ESXI_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional: password in plain text if the OS keyring is not available (not recommended)

environmentVariables.name: ESXI_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to verify the TLS certificate (default 0, accepts ESXi self-signed certs)
